h: The holiness of Israel and the forefathers

p: בַּהַפְטָרָה: "וְאַתָּה יִשְׂרָאֵל עַבְדִּי, יַעֲקֹב אֲשֶׁר בְּחַרְתִּיךָ, זֶרַע אַבְרָהָם אֹהֲבִי",
In the Haftarah: "But you, Israel, are My servant, Yaakov whom I have chosen, the seed of Avraham My friend," (Isaiah 41:8),
יֵשׁ לְהָבִין: אַחַר שֶׁזָּכַר שֵׁם יַעֲקֹב וְיִשְׂרָאֵל, לָמָּה הוּצְרַךְ לְיַיחֵס "זֶרַע אַבְרָהָם"?
one must understand: after mentioning the name of Yaakov and Israel, why was it necessary to trace the lineage to 'the seed of Avraham'?
וַהֲרֵי אָמְרוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה (בִּבְרֵאשִׁית רַבָּה פָּרָשָׁה עו): "הַבָּחוּר שֶׁבָּאָבוֹת – זֶה יַעֲקֹב",
Behold, our Sages of blessed memory stated (Bereishit Rabbah 76): "The choicest among the Patriarchs is Yaakov,"
וּבַזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ: "תֻּשְׁבַּחְתָּא דַּאֲבָהָן – יַעֲקֹב" (חֵלֶק א, קיט עַמּוּד ב וּשְׁאָר מְקוֹמוֹת),
and in the holy Zohar: "The praise of the Patriarchs is Yaakov" (I, 119b and other places),
וְכֵן אָמְרוּ (בִּבְרֵאשִׁית רַבָּה פָּרָשָׁה סג): "כְּדַאי הוּא אַבְרָהָם לְהִנָּצֵל בִּזְכוּתוֹ שֶׁל יַעֲקֹב",
and likewise they taught (Bereishit Rabbah 63): "Avraham was worthy of being rescued by virtue of the merit of Yaakov,"
וְלָמָּה יִחֵס אַחַר כָּךְ לְאַבְרָהָם?
so why did Scripture subsequently trace lineage back to Avraham?

paragraphs.text: Bereshit Rabbah 76:1: ““Jacob was very frightened and distressed. He divided the people who were with him, and the flocks, and the cattle, and the camels, into two camps” (Genesis 32:8). “Jacob was very frightened and distressed” – Rabbi Pinḥas in the name of Rabbi Reuven: The Holy One blessed be He made a promise to two people, but they were afraid; the chosen of the patriarchs, and the chosen of the prophets. The chosen of the patriarchs – this is Jacob, as it is stated: “For the Lord has chosen Jacob for Himself” (Psalms 135:4). The Holy One blessed be He said to him: “Behold, I am with you” (Genesis 28:15), but ultimately he was afraid, as it is stated: “Jacob was…frightened.” The chosen of the prophets – this is Moses, as it is stated; “Were it not for Moses, His chosen” (Psalms 106:23). The Holy One blessed be He said to him: “For I will be with you” (Exodus 3:12), but ultimately, he was afraid: “The Lord said to Moses: Do not fear him” (Numbers 21:34). He says: ‘Do not fear’ only to one who is afraid. Rabbi Berekhya and Rabbi Ḥelbo in the name of Rabbi Shmuel bar Naḥman in the name of Rabbi Natan: Israel would have been worthy of elimination in the days of Haman, had they not based their mindset on the mindset of their ancestor. They said: ‘If our patriarch Jacob, to whom the Holy One blessed be He promised and said: “Behold, I am with you,” (Genesis 28:15) was afraid, we, all the more so.’ That is what the prophet criticizes Israel: “You forgot the Lord your Maker, who spread the heavens and laid the foundation of the earth” (Isaiah 51:13). He said to them: ‘You have forgotten what He said to you: “So said the Lord: If the heavens above can be measured [and the foundations of the earth below probed, I too will spurn all the descendants of Israel because of everything that they did]” (Jeremiah 31:36) – if you see the heavens fall and the earth collapse. Should you not have learned from the spread of the heavens and the earth? Instead, “you feared continuously all day”’ (Isaiah 51:13).”

h: With you they conclude, and not with all of them

p: אַךְ הָעִנְיָן כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמַרְנוּ בְּמַה שֶּׁנֶּאֱמַר: "בְּךָ חוֹתְמִין וְלֹא בְּכוּלָּם",
However, the matter is as we stated regarding that which is taught: 'with you they conclude, and not with all of them,'
שֶׁהוּא שֶׁזֶּה זָכָה אַבְרָהָם אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר לוֹ: "אָנֹכִי מָגֵן לָךְ";
in that Avraham our Father, peace be upon him, uniquely merited this when it was said unto him: 'I am a shield to you';
"אָנֹכִי" בֵּיהּ כ' כֶּתֶר, כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב (זֹהַר חֵלֶק ג, רנו עַמּוּד ב),
'Anokhi' contains the letter Kaf symbolizing Keter, as written (Zohar III, 256b),
"מָגֵן לָךְ" – שֶׁלֹּא יִשְׁלוֹט בָּךְ יֵצֶר הָרָע וְלֹא תִּתְקַלְקֵל.
'a shield to you'—that the evil inclination hold no sway over you and you never become corrupted.
שֶׁאַחַר נִסָּיוֹן שְׁבִיעִי הֻבְטַח: "הִתְהַלֵּךְ לְפָנַי", שֶׁיִּהְיֶה מִתְהַלֵּךְ עַל יְדֵי הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ,
For after the seventh trial he was promised: 'Walk before Me,' that his steps be guided by Hashem,
וּבְנִסָּיוֹן חֲמִישִׁי הֻבְטַח שֶׁהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ יִהְיֶה מָגֵן לוֹ;
and at the fifth trial he was promised that Hashem would be a shield unto him;
אַף שֶׁצָּרִיךְ לְהִשְׁתַּדֵּל בְּעַצְמוֹ, מִכָּל מָקוֹם ה' עוֹזְרוֹ וּמָגֵן בַּעֲדוֹ שֶׁלֹּא יוּכַל הַיֵּצֶר הָרָע לִשְׁלוֹט בּוֹ.
for even though a person must exert effort himself, nonetheless Hashem assists him and shields him so that the evil inclination cannot dominate him.

h: Avraham’s devotion and the Zohar’s teaching

p: וּבְבִרְכַּת "הַגּוֹמֵל חֲסָדִים טוֹבִים",
And in the blessing of 'He Who bestows good kindnesses,'
שֶׁהוּא עַל יְדֵי שֶׁהָאָדָם מִתְעוֹרֵר לְמַטָּה בְּמִדַּת חֶסֶד מִדָּתוֹ שֶׁל אַבְרָהָם אָבִינוּ,
which is drawn down when a person awakens below the attribute of Chesed, the trait of Avraham our Father,
עַל יְדֵי זֶה אִתְעַר חֶסֶד לְעֵילָא, כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ג, צב רֵישׁ עַמּוּד ב),
through which Chesed is aroused Above, as written in the holy Zohar (III, 92a),
מְבַקְּשִׁים בִּבְרָכָה זוֹ: "וְכוֹף אֶת יִצְרֵנוּ לְהִשְׁתַּעְבֶּד לָךְ".
we petition within this blessing: 'and subjugate our inclination to be subservient unto You.'
וְכֵן בְּבִרְכַּת "אַהֲבַת עוֹלָם" מְבַקְּשִׁים: "וְיַחֵד לְבָבֵנוּ לְאַהֲבָה וּלְיִרְאָה אֶת שְׁמֶךָ",
And likewise in the blessing of 'Ahavat Olam' we plead: 'and unify our hearts to love and revere Your Name,'
שֶׁיִּהְיֶה לָנוּ לֵב אֶחָד לְיִרְאָה וּלְהוֹרִיק הָרַע מִלֵּב כְּסִיל,
that we possess a single heart to fear and to purge evil from the foolish heart,
שֶׁבְּרָכָה זוֹ נֶגֶד מִדַּת אַהֲבָה מִדָּתוֹ שֶׁל אַבְרָהָם אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם,
for this blessing corresponds to the attribute of Love, the trait of Avraham our Father, peace be upon him,
כְּמַה שֶּׁנֶּאֱמַר: "זֶרַע אַבְרָהָם אֹהֲבִי".
as is stated: 'the seed of Avraham My friend.'
וּכְבָר כָּתַב מוֹרֵנוּ רַבֵּינוּ רַב בֶּער זְצוּקַלְלָהּ"ה,
And our master Rabbi Dov Ber (the Maggid of Mezeritch), of blessed and holy memory, already wrote
שֶׁהָאַהֲבָה בָּאָה מִלְּמַעְלָה עַל דֶּרֶךְ "שֶׁכֵּן דַּרְכּוֹ וְכוּלֵי".
that love descends from Above, along the lines of 'such is his way, etc.'

paragraphs.text: Zohar, Emor 18:74 (III 92b): “We learned: An action below awakens an action above. If a person acts properly below, a corresponding power is awakened properly above. If a person performs kindness in the world, kindness is awakened above, rests upon that day, and crowns it on his account. If a person conducts himself mercifully below, mercy is awakened upon that day, and it is crowned with mercy on his account. Then that day stands over him as an advocate on his behalf when he needs it.”

paragraphs.text: Kisvei Rav Tzadok · Tzidkat HaTzadik 215:1: “Yet in truth, even a person’s longing for Torah and the knowledge of God is not wholly pure when his heart is not pure. The longing that naturally arises from it may be a desire like any other desire, like the desire to acquire wisdom and the like. Thus I heard concerning the verse, “The Lord was not in the wind …” (I Kings 19:11): will and ardor in love, and the tumult of awe, are all still not pure enough for the blessed God to dwell in them. Therefore the awe within the heart sets a boundary to love and constrains it so that it is only for the honor of Heaven. Their inclusion in one another is the quality of Jacob our father, who alludes to the Divine Name and to the human form in the chariot, the utmost perfection. Abraham our father himself was not completed until his tenth trial, the Binding, when he became included in Isaac’s quality, as the Zohar teaches (I, 119b), and as it is written, “Now I know that you fear God” (Genesis 22:12).”

Thus I heard concerning the verse, “The Lord was not in the wind …” (I Kings 19:11): will and ardor in love, and the tumult of awe, are all still not pure enough for the blessed God to dwell in them. Therefore the awe within the heart sets a boundary to love and constrains it so that it is only for the honor of Heaven. Their inclusion in one another is the quality of Jacob our father, who alludes to the Divine Name and to the human form in the chariot, the utmost perfection. Abraham our father himself was not completed until his tenth trial, the Binding, when he became included in Isaac’s quality, as the Zohar teaches (I, 119b), and as it is written, “Now I know that you fear God” (Genesis 22:12).”

paragraphs.text: Kisvei Ishbitz–Radzin · Sod Yesharim, The First Day of Pesach 13:1: “Hyssop alludes to such humility: a person recognizes that he has nothing from his own side, only what the blessed God shines upon him. As the blessed God shines upon him at each moment, so he is drawn after Him. When His will shines the quality of awe upon him, he is in awe; when He makes love shine within him, he immediately stands in love. For he recognizes well that he has nothing of his own, only what the blessed God bestows upon him. This is the meaning of the prayer, “May He place in our hearts His love and His fear”: we recognize well that even the love and awe found in our hearts are not ours, but that the blessed God places them within us. Hyssop alludes to this recognition: it is the small vav that nourishes the community of Israel, signifying humility.”

h: Israel My servant, Yaakov whom I have chosen

p: וְזֶה שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר: "יִשְׂרָאֵל עַבְדִּי יַעֲקֹב אֲשֶׁר בְּחַרְתִּיךָ",
And this is why Scripture states: "Israel My servant, Yaakov whom I have chosen,"
וְאַף שֶׁיִּצְרוֹ שֶׁל אָדָם מִתְגַּבֵּר בְּכָל יוֹם – "זֶרַע אַבְרָהָם אֹהֲבִי",
and although a person's inclination overpowers him every day—it adds: "the seed of Avraham My friend,"
שֶׁזָּכָה לְמַאֲמַר "אָנֹכִי מָגֵן לָךְ", שֶׁלֹּא תִּתְקַלְקֵל עוֹד.
who merited the divine proclamation 'I am a shield to you,' that you never become ruined.
וְעַל זֶה נֶאֱמַר: "וֶהְיֵה בְּרָכָה" – שֶׁתִּהְיֶה הֲוָיָה לַהַבְּרָכָה שֶׁלֹּא יִתְקַלְקֵל.
And regarding this it was stated: 'and you shall be a blessing'—that there be permanent existence (havayah) to the blessing, that it never be corrupted.
וּכְתִיב: "אַל תִּירָא וְגוֹמֵר",
And it is written: "Fear not, for I am with you; be not dismayed, for I am your God," (Isaiah 41:10),
שֶׁלֹּא תִּתְקַלְקֵל חַס וְשָׁלוֹם,
that you will not become corrupted, Heaven forbid,
"כִּי עִמְּךָ אָנִי" – כְּעִנְיַן מַה שֶּׁנֶּאֱמַר "אָנֹכִי מָגֵן לָךְ".
'for I am with you'—in the manner of that which is stated: 'I am a shield to you.'

h: Prayer and divine response and the Gemara’s teaching

p: וּכְתִיב: "אִמַּצְתִּיךָ" – נֶגֶד מַה שֶּׁנֶּאֱמַר: "וְיַחֵד לְבָבֵנוּ לְאַהֲבָה וְכוּלֵי";
And it is written: "I will strengthen you"—corresponding to what we pray: 'and unify our hearts to love, etc.';
"אַף עֲזַרְתִּיךָ" – נֶגֶד מַה שֶּׁנֶּאֱמַר: "וְכוֹף אֶת יִצְרֵנוּ לְהִשְׁתַּעְבֶּד לָךְ",
“yea, I will help you”—corresponding to what we pray: 'and subjugate our inclination to be subservient unto You,'
וְעַל פִּי מַה שֶּׁאָמְרוּ בַּגְּמָרָא: "וְאִלְמָלֵא הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא שֶׁעוֹזְרוֹ אֵינוֹ יָכוֹל לוֹ";
and based upon what they said in the Gemara: 'and were it not that the Holy One helps him, he could not withstand it';
"אַף תְּמַכְתִּיךָ בִּימִין צִדְקִי" –
“yea, I will uphold you with My righteous right hand”—
שֶׁזֶּה בָּא עַל יְדֵי אַבְרָהָם אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם שֶׁמִּדָּתוֹ חֶסֶד, דְּרוֹעָא יְמִינָא.
for this is channeled through Avraham our Father, peace be upon him, whose attribute is Chesed, the Supernal Right Arm.
